setup.command: missing=''; for t in go git-lfs sqlite3; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing $t"; done; if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "trustless dev setup: missing tools:$missing"; echo "install them yourself (see README, Development) — this hook never runs sudo or mutates your global toolchain"; fi; exit 0
